title: Polynomial-time composition with a bit output
statement: Let $p$ map bit strings to bits and let $g$ map bit strings to bit strings. If the function $x\mapsto [p(x)]$ is polynomial-time computable and $g$ is polynomial-time computable, then the function $x\mapsto [p(g(x))]$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: The one-bit output function $x\mapsto[p(x)]$ is polynomial-time computable.
